title: Step ladders and ladders for interior high cleaning
audience: Cleaners who use step ladders or ladders for interior high work, such as dusting high points, cleaning glazing above floor-level reach, or reaching vents and fittings.
learningOutcomes: Inspect a step ladder or ladder before use, and remove it from service if it is damaged.
Set up a ladder on a flat, firm surface, fully open where it is a step ladder, and keep it in the correct working position.
Apply the two-person rule and the single-climber rule to every task above floor-level reach.

instruction.heading: Why interior ladder work goes wrong
instruction.body: Most falls on interior tasks happen because the worker reaches too far, climbs above the safe top step, stands on something that was never meant to be climbed, or carries items while climbing. The ladder is one control and the working position is the other. Both are set before the first step is taken.

instruction.heading: Choosing and inspecting the equipment
instruction.body: Use only ladders that meet the Australian Standard the site specifies. Before each use, check the rungs or treads for looseness, and check screws, rivets, bolts, feet and locks for damage or looseness. Store ladders covered and supported so they do not sag. Remove a damaged ladder from service, tag it, and report it.

instruction.heading: Setting up
instruction.body: Place the ladder on a hard, flat, clear surface. Do not set a ladder on carpet edges, loose surfaces, boxes or furniture. A step ladder must be fully open and locked before anyone climbs it. Keep the work between shoulder height and arm's reach. If a point is out of reach, move the ladder rather than leaning or stretching sideways.

instruction.heading: Two people, one climber
instruction.body: When the work sits above floor-level reach, a second person steadies the base of the ladder and keeps passers-by away from it. Only one worker climbs at a given moment. The partner passes items up and receives them back down, and stays at the base for as long as the ladder is in use.

instruction.heading: Climbing, carrying and rotating work
instruction.body: Never carry kit up or down a ladder. Have the partner pass items up, or use a tool belt if the site approves one. Never climb onto window sills or ledges. Where the job is long, share the high work between people so that nobody spends extended time at height.

procedure: Inspect the ladder: rungs or treads, screws, rivets, bolts, feet and locks. Tag and remove any defective ladder.
Choose a hard, flat, clear position, and clear the area beneath the working point.
Open a step ladder fully and lock it. Set any ladder at a safe angle and check it is stable.
Put on the PPE the task requires, and place the wet floor sign and barrier.
Confirm the second person is positioned at the base and knows the task and the stop signal.
The person on the ladder climbs without carrying items, keeps weight central, and works at shoulder height.
Hand tools and cloths up or down through the second person, not by carrying them while climbing.
Come down, shift the ladder to the next position, and repeat. Never walk away from the ladder while someone is on it.
At the end, lower the ladder, clean it, store it covered and supported, and record any defect.

workedExamples.situation: A step ladder wobbles on the edge of a hallway carpet while you dust a high vent.
workedExamples.reasoning: Stop. Move the ladder to a firm, flat surface away from the carpet edge, check the locks and feet, and make sure it is fully open. If it still wobbles, remove it from service, tag it and report it. Do not adjust your balance by leaning on the wall.

workedExamples.situation: The top shelf in a boardroom needs dusting, and a colleague offers to hold the ladder while you carry the duster and a bucket up.
workedExamples.decisionPrompt: Is carrying the items up acceptable?
workedExamples.reasoning: No. Carrying items during the climb raises the chance of a fall. Go up empty-handed, and once you are in position ask your partner to pass the duster and bucket up. The partner stays at the ladder's base throughout.

equipmentAndPpe: Step ladder or ladder that meets the Australian Standard specified by the site
Duster or mini mop on an extension pole, where the task needs one
Gloves and eye protection for dusting and any chemical use, as the procedure requires

commonErrors.error: Standing on a chair, or on the top step of a step ladder, to get extra reach.
commonErrors.prevention: Use the ladder fully open and never climb above the marked top step or use furniture as a platform.

commonErrors.error: Two workers up the ladder together.
commonErrors.prevention: Only one climber at a time; the partner holds the bottom.

commonErrors.error: Leaning sideways to reach a point.
commonErrors.prevention: Move the ladder and keep the work within arm's reach.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Working at height may need a licence or authorisation in some states and territories, especially for powered platforms. This lesson does not grant any licence.
The reference document refers to ladder standards without giving a number.

The interior ladder rules in this lesson sit alongside the stop-work rule in “Window cleaning from the ground and with extension equipment”, and the work-at-height avoidance approach in the high-access window cleaning lessons.

qualityStandard: Each ladder is inspected and the check recorded before use.
The step ladder is fully open and locked, and the ladder is on a firm, flat surface.
A second person is in place for every task above floor-level reach.
No one carries equipment while climbing or descending.
documentationEvidence: Pre-use inspection record for the ladder
Defect tag and removal record where a defect is found
Task record showing that the two-person method was used
summary: Inspect, set up, and stop if the ladder is unsafe.
Two people for high work, and only one climber at a time.
Move the ladder rather than reach or lean.

knowledgeChecks.question: A step ladder wobbles while it stands on a carpet edge. What is the correct action?
options: Stand on the carpet edge, since the wobble is minor and it is only for a quick moment while you reach.
Stop, move it to a firm flat surface, check the locks and feet, and remove it from service if it still wobbles.
Stand on the top step for better reach, and keep one hand free for the cleaning tools and the cloth.

knowledgeChecks.question: What is the rule for a task above floor-level reach?
options: Two people may be on the ladder if they are careful.
A single climber at a time, with a partner holding the base.
The second person may climb up to take the items.

knowledgeChecks.question: What does completing the step-ladder lesson do, and what does it not do?
options: Completing it grants a licence to work at height for any ladder or step on any site, without further checks.
It does not grant any licence, and the state requirements for work at height have not yet been confirmed here.
It replaces the site's ladder inspection register and removes the need for the daily check at the start of each shift.
